title.narrative: Local Partner Health Services – Kigezi and Lango

description.narrative: (Uganda): LPHS Kigezi and Lango is implemented by the Joint Clinical Research Center and supports a population of 3.4 million across six districts in Kigezi and nine districts in the Lango region. With FY 2022 TB funds, this activity will support the following TB activities: 1) screening and detection of all forms of TB in infants, children, and adults at facility and community levels; 2) early initiation and completion of anti-TB treatment for all patients diagnosed with all forms of TB; 3) ensuring strong community systems to strengthen the continuum of TB prevention, screening, diagnosis, care, and treatment; 4) improving the quality of the multi-drug resistant TB program and TB/HIV collaborative activities through the implementation and scale-up of evidence-based community and facility interventions across the TB diagnostic, prevention, and treatment cascade.To ensure continuation of services during the COVID-19 pandemic, LPHS Kigezi and Lango will integrate infection prevention and control activities and support targeted provision of personal protective equipment, to protect service providers and beneficiaries of TB services. LPHS Kigezi and Lango will fund activities to improve gender equality and empower women to access and use high quality health services. By working closely with community partners including Village Health Teams (VHT) in increasing health seeking behavior, the activity will mitigate service disruption as a result of climatic conditions.Health systems strengthening activities are jointly supported with PEPFAR (HIV) funds, and therefore, this activity is co-funded with HIV/PEPFAR funds for the HSS cross-cutting areas at subnational level.....
